The engineering route

Each constraint shaped the system.

HPC handled adaptation; existing artifacts were merged and quantized in Colab. The current notebook is inference-only, so the local machine needs only a browser.

  1. Source

    Document, clean, and audit

    Record permissions and provenance, preprocess Reddit-derived data, scan identifiers, deduplicate, and freeze leakage-controlled splits.

    CSV + manifest
  2. Train

    Adapt on college HPC

    Apply LoRA to attention and MLP projections instead of updating every base-model parameter.

    PEFT adapters
  3. Merge

    Stream one shard at a time

    Fuse W + (α/r)BA, save the shard, release memory, and continue.

    Merged HF weights
  4. Compress

    Quantize in Colab

    Convert through FP16 GGUF, then produce Q4_K_M files stored on Drive.

    4.37–9.00 GB
  5. Serve

    Stream every token

    Keep one model resident in llama-server and send OpenAI-compatible SSE to Gradio.

    Live evaluation

Corpus composition

All rows came from Reddit. The labels describe themes.

The 30,324 scraped rows were cleaned and pre-processed into seven categories. The CSV column is named source, but its values are derived category labels—not separate acquisition origins.

Student visa interview experiences17,934
Complete consular debriefs7,813
Legal and regulatory Q&A2,894
Reddit travel and relocation742
Study-abroad advisory corpus693
Other verified labels248
Release gate

The full corpus is not public yet.

Row-level provenance, rightsholder permissions, privacy review, and takedown handling must be complete before redistribution. The latest local scan flagged 9 possible phone-pattern rows for private manual review; these are not confirmed identifiers.

Presentation walkthrough

Ask a representative question.

This browser-only walkthrough uses authored example answers. It is not a live model and does not provide legal advice.

Illustrative answerPassport status

What is the difference between ECR and ECNR?

ECR and ECNR are passport emigration-status categories used in specific Indian emigration contexts. The correct status and any clearance requirement depend on the passport holder, destination, and current official rules. Verify the passport endorsement and consult the latest Passport Seva and Protector General of Emigrants guidance before travel.

Verify against current official government sources.

The paper-quality benchmark

Engineering is complete enough to test. Comparison still needs evidence.

01

Freeze the test set

Deduplicate before splitting and group related source threads to prevent leakage.

02

Compare against bases

Use identical prompts and generation settings for base and fine-tuned checkpoints.

03

Rate what matters

Blind human review for correctness, relevance, completeness, and unsupported claims.

04

Report uncertainty

Publish category results, confidence intervals, agreement, latency, RAM, and errors.

Supported today

Artifacts, configurations, corpus structure, conversion path, streaming runtime.

Needs benchmark evidence

Quality ranking, improvement over base models, regulatory correctness, generalization.
